scope: PS3 Call of Duty and Uncharted resources linked from the user-supplied ImVirusMike PS3 hub
method: Browsed source pages and fetched their original HTML to inspect Google Sites custom embeds. Static showcase images were visually inspected. No tools, packages or payloads were executed.
cautions: A source-page checkmark, VirusTotal link or claim of being clean is not independent safety verification and must not be repeated as a safety guarantee.
RTM tools are desktop helpers. A downloaded EXE or DLL cannot run in the PS3 web browser or be installed through Package Manager.
SPRX and package compatibility is specific to the game update, region and console mode. Blanket headings on the source do not prove every listed file supports every HEN, CEX or DEX configuration.
DLC fix packages and license-bypass files are deliberately excluded. Official add-ons still require the matching game region and a valid entitlement.
Source names and filenames disagree for several BO1 embeds. Unresolved identities remain separate; archive-confirmed identities retain a note about the source mismatch.
Uncharted reference offsets are developer research for specific game IDs and versions, not a compatibility claim for the separately linked VirusMike installer.
